declarations.docstring: A linear equivalence between two representations that commutes with the action of every group element.
Twisting both representations by the same character preserves an intertwining linear equivalence.
The inverse of an intertwining linear equivalence is again intertwining.
The composite of compatible intertwining linear equivalences is intertwining.
Twisting a representation by the trivial character leaves it unchanged.
For an antitone natural weight, every natural twist power admits an intertwining equivalence with the uniformly shifted weight representation.
The linear equivalence underlying an isomorphism of finite-dimensional representations intertwines their actions.
A shifted weight representation admits a linear equivalence intertwining the indicated general linear group actions.
